serviceRecords.overview:
Houston Food Bank partner pantries are locations where those in need can receive food with a focus on fresh, nutritious food, particularly fruits and vegetables. Food may be free-choice similar to a grocery store setup or pre-packaged. Sites may be closed during major holidays or inclement weather.

As a food rescue organization, Houston Food Bank works to help reduce waste and support food access. Neighbors can expect supplemental assistance rather than full grocery replacement and may see produce that might not be as beautiful as in a grocery store - but it will be just as tasty and nutritious!
